candidate_changes: S1: subtract league mean xRV per (pitch_type x balls x strikes x stand x season) cell
empirical_bayes_shrinkage: shrink pitcher-season scores toward league mean
drop_season: remove season from feature set if adoption criteria met
add_p_throws: add pitcher handedness if adoption criteria met

lgbm_settings.note: Reuse v2 classifier parameters; fixed tree counts; no early stopping on held-out data

metric_definitions.YoY_stability: Pearson correlation of pitcher-season scores across consecutive season pairs (excluding pairs touching 2020)
metric_definitions.split_half_reliability: Pearson r between odd/even pitch halves for same pitcher-season
metric_definitions.next_season_BB_corr: Pearson r(Location+ S, BB% S+1) on qualified pitcher-seasons
metric_definitions.incremental_delta_R2: delta R^2 from adding Location+(S) to last-season BB% to predict S+1 BB%
metric_definitions.AUC: area under ROC curve per classifier
metric_definitions.pitcher_season_corr_v2_v3: Pearson r of v2 vs v3 pitcher-season scores

rules.qualified_pitcher_season: >=300 pitches (2020: scaled by games played ratio ~0.37-0.40, i.e. >=111 pitches)
rules.run_value_fix: If event run-value table is not count-specific, replace with count-specific table for all later work. Defect correction, not optimization.
rules.S1_adoption: Adopt S1 if share of pitcher-season score variance explained by pitch-type and count mix alone is >=0.10 AND S1 not significantly worse than S0 on split-half reliability or any outcome correlation (paired pitcher-clustered 95% CI includes 0 or favors S1). Otherwise keep S0.
rules.shrinkage_adoption: Adopt empirical-Bayes shrinkage if split-half reliability at 300-pitch threshold is <0.70 OR shrunk score improves next-season correlation with CI above 0. Otherwise leave unshrunk; set leaderboard minimum to pitch count where reliability reaches 0.70 (rounded up to nearest 50).
rules.drop_season: Drop season only if variant-vs-V0a corr >= (reseed-vs-V0a corr - 0.005) AND CIs of differences in held-out log loss and outcome correlations include 0.
rules.add_p_throws: Add p_throws only if held-out log loss improves (CI excluding 0) on >=2 of 4 binary classifiers, next-season BB% corr does not worsen, and pitcher-season corr with Stuff+ v4 rises by <=0.05. Default omit.
rules.unseen_seasons_policy: Score with season set to each nearest trained season and average event probabilities (2020: average of 2019 and 2021; future season: latest trained).
rules.era_check: If 2015 plate_x or plate_z distribution has KS stat >0.05 vs 2016, exclude 2015 from training and say so; otherwise include it.
rules.next_season_bar: Consecutive pairs only, excluding any pair involving 2020; both seasons >=300 pitches: (i) corr(Location+ S, BB% S+1) <=-0.20 final model and <=-0.15 pitcher-holdout; (ii) incremental delta-R^2 from adding Location+(S) to last-season BB% when predicting S+1 BB%: point estimate >0 in both versions and CI lower bound >0 for final-model version.

stop_ship_gates.correlations_sign: correlations with ERA and xFIP negative, corr with BB% <=-0.20
stop_ship_gates.yoy_floor: no consecutive-season YoY pair (excluding pairs touching 2020) below 0.30
stop_ship_gates.seasons_scored: all seasons 2015-2026 scored with 2020 flagged 60-game season
